verdict.rationale: LightSprint is a task-board and review platform that orchestrates agents, not purely a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. The only MCP evidence ('1,000+ integrations via MCP') shows LightSprint acting as a client that connects to external services. Nothing documents a first-party MCP server that external agents can connect to, and the docs.lightsprint.ai/llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
